college_identity.identity_notes: Formerly Regional Engineering College, Warangal (RECW); renamed NIT Warangal in 2002; Institute of National Importance since 2007. First of the 31 NITs established (foundation stone laid 1959). Single main campus (~248-256 acres, figures vary slightly by source) divided by NH 202 into staff quarters, CCE, and main campus. No conflicting institutions of similar name found.

review_items.review_title: What is the bad thing about the NIT in Warangal?
review_items.extraction_note: This Quora page appears to contain at least two distinct answers with very different registers: one is a raw, emotionally charged first-person account; another reads as a structured, categorized summary of criticisms (possibly a more curated/composed answer). Both are preserved as evidence but the difference in tone/reliability is flagged rather than blended into one entry.

aspect_evidence.evidence_summary: First-person answer describes some faculty (naming department HOD specifically) as 'abusive, arrogant, cheap mindset and proud,' claiming they do not listen to students and are dismissive. Strongly negative, personally charged framing; presented as this individual's characterization rather than a verified institutional pattern.

Same or an adjacent answer on this thread: 'College infrastructure? Very poor. Old buildings and old hostels. Even the labs and lab equipment are not well maintained.' Also states students feel they lack 'enough freedom to explore and experiment.'

A more structured, categorized answer on the same page describes: 'Rigid curriculum for some programs: slow curricular updates... Variable teaching quality: standout professors coexist with instructors whose pedagogical skills are weaker... Overemphasis on exams: assessment culture prioritizes rote learning over continuous assessment.'
Same structured answer: 'Hostel crowding and maintenance issues: several hostels experience space constraints, maintenance delays and uneven upkeep across blocks.'

review_items.review_title: How are hostel facilities at NIT Warangal (boys)?

aspect_evidence.evidence_summary: 'Other than 2nd year hostels are nice. In first year you will get double seater room in 1.8k hostel which is India's largest hostel. It has mostly every facility which requires like book stall, gym, laundry, xerox shop, lifts, and snacks shop.' Implies 2nd-year hostels specifically are the exception to otherwise positive hostel conditions.
